comments_data.body: Hello Ian, I'm still working on this PR.

Hello @lilitkarapetyan - I've just been able to reproduce an issue I saw yesterday.

* yarn develop
* log in as `Mar-4`
* edit document owned by `Mar-4`
* change document `description` by adding a couple of words
* press `Save`
* data in table doesn't update

I checked the database, and the new record is in there.
I checked the console, and saw this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/199940686-82254f00-aa56-43c2-aafc-a9070c573553.png)

So, it looks like we're receiving the new message twice, and ignoring the new version.

Note: I'm pretty sure I'm not just getting this on browser that does the `Save`. I think I get it on other logged in browsers, too.

Have you been able to successfully edit/save a document?

Another issue, please @lilitkarapetyan 

When we save a document from `My orders`, it increments the `.message.Reference`.  

I'm pretty sure that in `checkReference` we should only find/generate a reference number if the `Reference` field is something like `null` or `''`.  I don't think we can check for `undefined`, because I think that would generate a `Reference` for templates that don't include a `Reference` field.

@lilitkarapetyan - there was an issue, where if we edit/save a message, the old and new instances of the message were displayed.  I've found the [fix](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/1999/commits/f6376c0d8a5713d2a457d6cb64f40858a6ea37b2#diff-f97fc21549a839fe120adefe5de4fc716b655a6bcc52eb70d83868a04aaea726R42) for it, in `handle-channel-updates` - `handleNonInfoMessage`.  

The issue was because we're 1/2 through moving from `Reference` to `reference`.   Damn, I can't remember why I wanted to move to lower-case `reference`.  But, it's fortunate we did it, because currently `serge` is updating the `Reference` on every message sent, rather than only doing it for newly created messages.  I'll check we have that issue captured.

review_comments_data.body: @lilitkarapetyan - I'd like use to store the template id in `messageType`, please.  That means Serge won't fail if the template title is changed.
@lilitkarapetyan - this method refers to `formId`.  Should it include `formId` in the hook props?
Yes, because only components containing SaveMessageButton have a formId

thanks for the fixes @lilitkarapetyan 

_One day_ I look forward to `handle-initial-channel-messages` getting refactored & tidied up
this one was a weird one to diagnose. Thanks!

issues.title: Save and Edit documents in `My Orders` panel
issues.body:
In the `PlanningChannel` we have the `My Orders` tab.  When the rows in this table are expanded, we use JSON-editor to display the contents.

While the orders are initially show read-only `[*]`, the owner of each message (`message.details.from.roleId === playerRoleId`) should have an `Edit button`.  They can then make document edits and then `Save` or `Cancel` the edit.

`[*]` `<JsonEditor>` is currently _ignoring_ the `disabled` property. Bug in #1973
